title: Clean experience
body: Simple and does what i want it to do.
author: mulando99

title: Nice and easy
body: It's cool and handy and seems to work perfect. I'm using it to help me develop important daily habits. Thanks for providing us with this amazing tool!
author: Francisco 3425

title: Simple and sleek
body: This app is very helpful - the little blip as I record a habit is like clicker-training myself! I would love to be able to have the options to record some habits unlimited times a day, and not just once a day. Also I would enjoy a long-time visualiser of my achievements, badges and goals. I do enjoy the sleek and simple design, and adding my own backgrounds helps a lot with motivation (i.e. bad teeth for flossing), but if the correct habit/picture showed up as I click a reminder that would be helpful. Over all a nice and helpful app, which I use multiple times a day!
author: Jerker Kung

title: Very nice app!
body: This app is doing exactly what I need - helps me acquire and track my habits and regular activities. The interface is beautiful and easy to use. Integration with Health app also comes quite handy and provides good addition to my health related activities.
author: devoto13

title: Dyr!
body: Bra app, men för att kunna använda den måste man betala 50kr som in app köp. Alldeles för dyr med tanke på hur simpel den är.
